description: A 'run prettier before commit' nag dominates the corpus (five recurrences) but is irrelevant to pointing the client at staging. The single relevant entry — the API base URL must come from an environment variable — was stated once. This tests precision under a dominant-but-irrelevant theme: recurrence promotes the prettier cluster and lets it crowd out the one on-topic correction, while a recency control catches the recent env-URL entry.
